The '''2024 [[Eliteserien]]''' was the 80th season of top-tier [[Association football|football]] in Norway. This was the eighth season of Eliteserien after rebranding from Tippeligaen.

The season started on 31 March 2024 and ended on 1 December 2024, not including play-off matches.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.eliteserien.no/nyheter/her-er-hovedterminlisen-for-eliteserien-2024|title=Her er hovedterminlisten for Eliteserien 2024|website=eliteserien.no|access-date=3 January 2024}}</ref>

[[FK Bodø/Glimt|Bodø/Glimt]] were the defending champions. [[Fredrikstad FK|Fredrikstad]], [[KFUM-Kameratene Oslo|KFUM]] and [[Kristiansund BK|Kristiansund]] joined as the promoted clubs from the [[2023 Norwegian First Division]]. They replaced [[Vålerenga Fotball|Vålerenga]], [[Stabæk Fotball|Stabæk]] and [[Aalesunds FK|Aalesund]], who were relegated to the [[2024 Norwegian First Division]].

Bodø/Glimt successfully defended their title, winning their fourth title in five years, and earned an entry to the [[2025–26 UEFA Champions League#Play-off round|2025-26 UEFA Champions League play-off round]].

==Teams==
Sixteen teams compete in the league – the top thirteen teams from the previous season and three teams promoted from the [[2023 Norwegian First Division|First Division]]. The promoted teams were [[Fredrikstad FK|Fredrikstad]], [[KFUM-Kameratene Oslo|KFUM]] and [[Kristiansund BK|Kristiansund]]. Kristiansund and Fredrikstad were promoted after respectively 1 and 11 seasons absent, while KFUM were promoted for the first time in their history. They replaced [[Vålerenga Fotball|Vålerenga]], [[Stabæk Fotball|Stabæk]] and [[Aalesunds FK|Aalesund]], ending their top flight spells of 22 years, 1 year and 2 years respectively.
